chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah Jabala, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'One in Ihram kissed a boy out of desire.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He is whipped one hundred lashes.'

key_terms.سَوْطٍ: A whip or lash, used here for the punishment of flogging
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: One in the state of Ihram, a ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for kissing a boy out of desire while in Ihram?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies the hadd penalty of one hundred lashes for a muhrim who kisses a boy out of sexual desire, linking the ritual state of Ihram to specific sexual misconduct rulings. This ruling is often discussed in Shia jurisprudence alongside the penalty for sodomy (liwat), highlighting the severity of sexual acts committed during the sacred state of pilgrimage. The specificity of 'kissing' rather than full intercourse suggests a distinct legal category or a preparatory act within the broader context of sexual penalties in Ihram.
